items.title: client/v3.0.1
items.summary: This is the first patch release of the Milvus Go SDK v3, targeting Milvus 3.0.1. It is compared against client/v3.0.0.This is a stable release for Milvus 3.0. It is not guaranteed to be compatible with Milvus 2.6 servers.HighlightsAdds element-level nullability and nested Array<T> fields, including struct sub-field add and drop support.Adds the full Row-Level Security (RLS) SDK surface: row policies, principal tags, and a count-only principal listing mode.Adds array / struct / JSON path replacement (WithPathReplace) for partial upserts.Preserves primary keys in full AutoID upserts so deletes and inserts route to the same VChannel.Adds lightweight snapshot summaries (ListSnapshotSummaries) alongside the legacy names-only listing.Adds Timestamptz and Geometry support to row-based inserts, and fixes read-back coercion of RFC3339Nano ISO timestamptz strings into time.Time.Adds zero-copy aliasing for common slice-typed template parameters, avoiding heap duplication of large in {list} membership sets.Bumps milvus-proto/go-api/v3 from v3.0.1 to v3.0.6, and gRPC to v1.84.0 (fixing CVE-2026-84304 and releasing server request buffers right after decoding).SDK version is now 3.0.1 (was 3.0.0).Breaking Changes and MigrationGo version: The module's go directive is bumped to Go 1.25.0 (from 1.24.9).Template parameter lifetime contract: slice-valued WithTemplateParam values ([]int64, []string, []float64, []bool) are no longer copied. Do not mutate a slice passed to WithTemplateParam while the Search/Query call using it is in flight, and do not mutate it after Request() returns. Pass a copy if the caller intends to keep writing to the slice.Upsert now always retains an AutoID primary key as its lookup key. Full AutoID Upsert requires Query availability and a loaded target.New protobuf messages: ListSnapshots now carries optional snapshotSummaries. Servers that return only names are reported as unsupported by ListSnapshotSummaries.Installation:go get github.com/milvus-io/milvus/client/v3@v3.0.1New FeaturesRow-Level Security (RLS): Added the complete client surface for the 3.0 RLS backport:Row policies: CreateRowPolicy, UpdateRowPolicy, DropRowPolicy, ListRowPolicies with NewCreateRowPolicyOption / NewUpdateRowPolicyOption (WithUsingExpr / WithCheckExpr / WithDescription) and the corresponding list option.Principal tags: SetRLSPrincipalTags, GetRLSPrincipalTags, DeleteRLSPrincipalTags (delete selected keys or all keys).Principal listing: ListRLSPrincipals returns names plus an int64 count, with WithCountOnly for a count-only response. (#53932, #50263, #54246)RLS is threaded through read and write paths: WithRLSPrincipal / WithSkipRLS on Search, Query, Search/Query iterators, column-based and row-based Insert/Upsert/Delete options, and the REST bulk importer. (#53932)Element-level nullability: Array and vector-array columns now support null elements in addition to null rows:NewElementNullableColumnXxxArray constructors for all scalar array types and vector arrays (Float, Float16, BFloat16, Binary, Int8 vectors), with ElementNullableColumn interface accessors (ElementNullable, ElementLen, ElementValidData, ElementIsNull) and WithRowValidData / WithElementSparseMode options. Compact (insert) and sparse (result) storage modes are both supported.Null elements are expressed as nil pointers ([]*T / [][]*T) on insert and read-back. (#54975, #51162)Nested Array<T> fields: Added ColumnXxxArrayArray columns (e.g. ColumnInt64ArrayArray) for Array<Array<T>> struct sub-fields, with NewElementNullableColumnXxxArrayArray constructors adding row / element / leaf validity layers and NestedArrayColumn accessors (LeafType, LeafNullable, LeafValidData, LeafIsNull). (#54975, #51162)Struct sub-field evolution: AddCollectionField (and NewAddCollectionFieldOption) now accepts a struct[sub_field] path to add an element of an existing struct, via AlterCollectionSchema; a legacy Unimplemented server is reported instead of failing silently. Validation enforces nullable=true for the sub-field and reuses entity.NewStructSchema().WithField. entity.Field.WithElementNullable sets leaf nullability of an Array<T> struct sub-field. (#54975)Path replacement: Added WithPathReplace(fieldName, path) to the column-based and row-based partial-update options, replacing one scalar Array element, a complete StructArray element, one child of a struct element, or a value under an explicit JSON field (including a missing final object key and JSON null). (Milvus #53746, #53016)Snapshot summaries: Added Client.ListSnapshotSummaries, returning lightweight server-side summaries in the server order (create_ts / create_utc_ts) without a per-name DescribeSnapshot round-trip. Names-only responses are rejected with ErrServiceUnimplemented. (#54981, #52635)Full AutoID Upsert: Existing rows retain their primary keys (read-based preparation sharing Partial Upsert), so insert and delete for an entity route to the same VChannel; missing lookup keys get allocator-generated IDs and emit i
